items.topic: Where the full judo-ng read findings live
items.claim: Agent assumed the judo-ng findings were in target/agent-docs-review/review.md (56 findings, pass 1).
items.fact: The full judo-ng code review (~1200 bugs) is in target/judo-ng-read/: findings.md (1,147,326 bytes; 2864 entries: 1210 [bug], 1405 [doc], 249 [dox]; full what/expected text, no location), findings_rows.json (5-column rows [kind, repo, 'repo@sha:file:line', text truncated, ''], same order), review.md (coverage: 103 repos, 577 batches, 9280 files documented, 2864 flagged). target/agent-docs-review/ is only the smaller template verification (56 findings: BE 12, DE 9, E2E 5, FE 18, IT 4, MO 8).

items.topic: Operator: findings are from a sibling session, not agent-docs-review
items.claim: Agent presented target/agent-docs-review/review.md as the judo-ng issues.
items.fact: Operator: 'not that a session i did a full review in a sibling sesison which have found 1200 issues in the code'. Look in target/judo-ng-read, not the agent-docs-review pass.

items.claim: Joining findings.md to findings_rows.json by position over all entries or by evidence line.
items.fact: findings.md [bug] blocks contain only '**what:**' and '**expected:**' (the 'evidence' line is on doc entries only). Bug blocks align 1:1 in order with the [bug] rows of findings_rows.json (1210/1210 aligned), but not across all kinds (2615 mismatches when zipping all 2864). Join per kind, in order: location = rows[2] ('repo@sha:path:line'), full text from findings.md.

items.claim: Actor lookup uses pathInfo.startsWith('/' + FQN-as-path) with no segment boundary and findAny().
items.fact: A path for MyActorX matches MyActor; when one actor FQN prefixes another, findAny() returns first in list order. Expected: match exact segment (equals prefix or startsWith prefix + '/') and prefer the longest matching FQN.

items.claim: openspec/specs/spring/spec.md:93: module SHALL throw AntlrRuntimeIncompatibilityException if ANTLR runtime version does not match expected version.
items.fact: AntlrCheckBeanRegistration does not compare versions; it reflectively checks that org.antlr.runtime.Token declares an EOF_TOKEN field and throws AntlrRuntimeIncompatibilityException('The antlr-runtime version must be < 3.5') when it is missing.

items.topic: createQueryFilterType creates element before type check
items.claim: createQueryFilterType calls ctx.create, setElementId and sets name before operator type check, then returns null for unsupported primitives (PasswordType, BinaryType, XMLType).
items.fact: Expected: check primitive type before creating target element, or document why null is acceptable for a TransformFunction. Unverified whether the already-created element is removed from the model (suspicion only).

items.claim: Catalog lacks coverage of several topics listed in knowledge-gaps-report.md.
items.fact: Gap topics: generated DB schema naming/audit columns/indexes; frontend OIDC metadata, logout, guest access; JCL operation-body language reference; undocumented frontend extension points; custom JAX-RS resources/REST-only endpoints; MUI X Pro/Premium license config; test-suite multi-JVM heap exhaustion hiding unrun classes; local e-mail testing with Mailpit incl. Keycloak realm SMTP; optimistic locking (__version); expression variable categories beyond ACTOR/PRINCIPAL and custom providers; type mapping and type-level constraints; parameterized queries and parameter ranges. Report at openspec/changes/restructure-blueprints-for-kb/knowledge-gaps-report.md.

items.topic: Tool stubs: context-mode outdated, kb index stale
items.fact: kb_search warned 'index refresh still running — results may be stale'; ctx_execute warns context-mode v1.0.169 outdated (v2.1.4 available). flow_results list returned nothing for non-flow work. Operator preference: when asked for a file, print its full path rather than opening canvas or generating a new report ('NO print me the path of the fule the codes have').

items.topic: Operator: print the path, no new report
items.claim: Agent kept building a bugs-report.md with full paths of code files.
items.fact: Operator wanted the path of the file holding the findings, not a generated report. Agent deleted bugs-report.md (mismatched locations).
